'''Otoh-D'in''' was a paradise located in a [[Swamp/Legends|swampland]] according to the [[Gungan religion|mythology]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was created by [[Balam]], the first Gungan [[Militiagung/Legends|warrior]], after he was turned into one of the [[Gud/Legends|guds]] by [[Oma-Oma]], the chief [[God/Legends|deity]]. Otoh-D'in was regarded as the afterlife for the bravest Gungan [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], where, after receiving a makeover, they would spend eternity distracting themselves with strategy games. If [[Ossorus]], the home of the guds, were to be attacked by forces such as [[Mekamok]], the god of destruction, Balam would lead the [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] warriors to defend it.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otoh-D'in was mentioned in the Gungan DataBank entry in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
